title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot response personalization - Memory citations
description: When Copilot Chat uses memory to personalize a response, users can now see what informed the answer. Select Sources beneath the response, then open the Personalization tab to view the custom instructions, saved memories, memories learned from conversations, and past chats that shaped the response. From there, users can return to a cited chat to pick up where they left off or review and delete saved memories. Memory citations appear only when memory is turned on.
